desktop.notes:
• Click an album: its photos in this folder. Click it again: the whole album right in the grid - from every folder and the Library (Curish too) - under a bright LIBRARY ALBUM bar; the folder name fades. Once more: every photo of the folder.
• In a Library album, photos from other folders are for looking; Keep / Discard / crop work on this folder's photos.
• The separate album window from beta.19 is gone.
